name: items
description: The languages to display within the language navigation.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Name of the language, written in that language (for example, "Cymraeg" for Welsh). If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use for the language item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: lang
params.description: The language tag for the language item text (for example, `cy` for Welsh). Added as a `lang` attribute so that assistive technologies pronounce the language name correctly.

params.name: hrefLang
params.description: The language tag for the linked page (for example, `cy` for Welsh). Added as an `hreflang` attribute for search engines and other machine readers. Defaults to `lang` when omitted.

params.name: dir
params.description: The text direction of the script the language name is written in (`ltr` for left-to-right scripts or `rtl` for right-to-left). Set this on every item if the navigation includes scripts written in different directions.

params.name: href
params.description: Link to the current page in this language.

params.name: current
params.description: Whether this is the language of the current page. Defaults to `true` when `href` is not provided.

params.name: languageDescriptionText
params.description: Visually hidden text after a language link to indicate what the link will do. Write it in the language of the link (for example, "Change the language to English").

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes to add to the language item anchor.

name: ariaLabel
description: Plain text label identifying the navigation landmark to screen readers. Write it in the language of the current page. Defaults to "Language navigation".

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the language navigation container.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the language navigation container.
